mods.name: Kiln Speedrun Timer
mods.works: Automatic splits: Nether, Bastion, Fortress, Blind, Stronghold, End, Finish. RTA and IGT. Personal best with deltas.
mods.note: The Kiln project's own Fabric mod

mods.name: Illager Warship
mods.works: Its warship generates in new worlds.

mods.name: Heart Crystals
mods.works: Using a crystal raises max health; hearts are kept with the world and through respawns.
mods.note: From Modrinth, unchanged; install it in Horizon's mod browser too (its data), and its jar in kiln/mods (its code)

mods.name: Armour Durability HUD
mods.works: Each piece of armour worn, its icon and what is left of it, on the HUD.

mods.name: Better Than Mending
mods.works: Sneaking, a right click with a worn item that has Mending repairs it with the player's experience.

mods.name: SpongeSucc (Lava Sponge)
mods.works: A lava sponge placed beside lava takes it up and turns into a hot lava sponge.
mods.note: From Modrinth, unchanged; install it in Horizon's mod browser too (its blocks), and its jar in kiln/mods (its code). Its lava dripping onto dripstone is a Mixin, not applied yet

mods.name: Tech Reborn
mods.works: Its machines, cables and panels stand in the world, and in the development builds its iron furnace smelts by its own code; energy and screens come next.
mods.note: From Modrinth, unchanged; the goal of the project
